repository.name: @webex/plugin-attachment-actions
repository.purpose: Public plugin registered as webex.attachmentActions for the submit actions of adaptive cards attached to Webex messages, through the Webex REST API attachment/actions resource (catalog service hydra): create POSTs the caller's attachment action unchanged as a JSON body and get takes a record or id and resolves the record. listen() builds a webhook-style event envelope, connects the Mercury socket, and turns conversation activities with the verb cardAction into created events built from the activity alone, with Hydra attachment action, message, person, and room ids and the decrypted card inputs; a conversion error is logged and drops the event. Importing the package also registers the conversation and mercury internal plugins. Nothing is cached or persisted.

Add a unit suite and script before recording a command here.

public_interfaces.name: @webex/plugin-attachment-actions package entry
public_interfaces.audience: SDK bundles (webex, webex-node) and applications that build their own webex instance
public_interfaces.notes: Importing the package registers the internal plugins conversation (whose payload transformer decrypts socket activities and card inputs) and mercury, then AttachmentActions as public plugin 'attachmentActions' with no config; the first registration of the name wins. The default export AttachmentActions is the only export.

public_interfaces.name: webex.attachmentActions methods and events
public_interfaces.audience: applications and the workspace sample browser-socket
public_interfaces.notes: create POSTs the caller's object unchanged to hydra attachment/actions and get GETs attachment/actions by record or id; get(undefined) throws synchronously. listen() needs spark:all and spark:kms; each call adds another Mercury listener. Only the verb cardAction gives created, built from the activity alone with Hydra ids and the inputs when present; there is no personEmail. A conversion error is logged through webex.logger.error and drops the event. onWebexApiEvent and getattachmentActionEvent are marked @private.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not build Hydra ids by hand or with a fixed cluster.
negative_guidance.why: Event ids must match the ids the attachment actions resource returns (INV-002).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not let a conversion error escape getattachmentActionEvent or trigger a partial event.
negative_guidance.why: A failure is one error log line and no event (INV-004).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not fill an event without deep-cloning the stored envelope.
negative_guidance.why: One envelope is shared by every event (INV-003).

negative_guidance.rule: Do not log card inputs, ids, or email addresses through webex.logger.
negative_guidance.why: Inputs carry what users typed; only the fixed conversion error line is logged today.

negative_guidance.rule: Do not treat README.md as the behavior reference.
negative_guidance.why: Its heading names the messages plugin and it shows no usage; see docs/adr/0001-retain-product-readme.md.
